sources.notes: Raw embedded Next.js React Flight data fetched 2026-10-08 (fetch date; no board-wide timestamp). Exact versions and every published effort retained at full precision, with exact-run speed and published USD/task. Absent older entries are preserved for this narrow rollout. Estimated indexes and multi-model agents excluded. Coding host checkpoint and the owner’s canonical modelRelease mapping are retained; Haiku rows explicitly map private verrine EAP hosts to released Haiku 5.5. Original recovery telemetry and older-checkpoint fallbacks are visible; no unpublished fallback-as-failure score is fabricated. Explicit exact-run effort metadata already verified in the 2026-09-30 owner pull is preserved when the current abbreviated display has the identical variant/value but omits effort; effortSourceUpdated records that provenance.
sources.costDateBasis: Fetch date; no board-wide timestamp published
